requirements.acceptance_reason: Clear, boolean-testable rule: omit the key entirely rather than returning null or partial proximity objects, which is a clean API contract decision I can implement.

requirements.requirement: The system must handle missing user location by returning clinical trials without proximity data and without raising an exception.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Graceful degradation when user location is absent is boolean-testable and critical for a good user experience; clear implementation path.

requirements.requirement: The system must handle upstream service failure (clinical_trials_service error) by returning clinical trials without proximity data while preserving core trial results.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Standard resilience requirement ensuring upstream proximity service failures don't break core trial results; boolean-testable and implementable with try/except in the facade.

requirements.requirement: The system must ensure that proximity data is aligned to the correct trial record and not mismatched across trials.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Critical correctness requirement ensuring proximity data is keyed/matched to the correct trial (e.g., by NCT ID); boolean-testable and essential.

requirements.requirement: The system must include a proximity object in each clinical trial response returned by evaluate_care_facade when proximity data is available.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Clear, boolean-testable requirement to include a proximity object in evaluate_care_facade clinical trial responses; implementation path through the facade is straightforward.

requirements.requirement: The system must populate proximity.distance_miles, proximity.duration_minutes, and proximity.normalized_score fields exactly as produced by clinical_trials_service.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Specifies the exact fields to pass through from clinical_trials_service, which is boolean-testable and directly codeable.

requirements.requirement: The system must preserve the original clinical trial fields and append proximity data without removing or renaming existing attributes.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Valid architectural constraint ensuring backward compatibility of existing trial response fields; boolean-testable via schema comparison.

requirements.requirement: The system must ensure the proximity.normalized_score value is returned as a numeric value between 0 and 100 inclusive.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Clear numeric range constraint on normalized_score that is boolean-testable and enforceable at the facade layer.

requirements.requirement: The system must route enriched clinical trial objects through tool_router without schema validation errors.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Valid constraint ensuring tool_router schema accommodates the enriched trial object; testable by passing enriched objects through the router without errors.

requirements.requirement: The system must not recompute proximity scores within evaluate_care_facade and must only pass through values from clinical_trials_service.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Clear architectural constraint that the facade is pass-through only; boolean-testable by verifying no computation logic exists in evaluate_care_facade.

requirements.requirement: The system must return proximity as null or omit the proximity field when upstream proximity data is unavailable for a trial.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Clear graceful-degradation requirement for missing proximity data per trial; boolean-testable by checking response when upstream data is absent.

requirements.requirement: The system must successfully return clinical trial results even if proximity data is missing for all trials.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Essential resilience requirement ensuring trial results are returned even with no proximity data whatsoever; boolean-testable.

requirements.requirement: The system must handle partial proximity data (e.g., missing duration_minutes) by returning null for missing fields without failing the entire response.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Clear partial-data handling requirement; boolean-testable by sending a trial with incomplete proximity fields and verifying null substitution without response failure.

requirements.requirement: The system must maintain response latency within existing facade performance thresholds after adding proximity data.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Valid non-functional constraint that adding proximity pass-through must not degrade facade latency beyond existing thresholds; testable via performance benchmarks.

requirements.requirement: The system must log an error event when proximity data fails to attach due to schema mismatch or serialization issues.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Clear observability requirement to log errors on schema mismatch or serialization failure; boolean-testable by inducing a malformed proximity object and checking logs.

stories.title: Unit and integration tests for proximity scoring
stories.description: Add tests validating distance/duration ingestion, scoring normalization, and API response structure. Include edge cases (missing location, zero distance, long-distance outliers).
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/tests/ (existing test patterns) + clinical_trials_service.py
stories.acceptance_reason: Test patterns exist under backend/tests/, the edge cases are explicitly enumerated, and the dependencies are correct — this is buildable and necessary for acceptance.

requirements.requirement: The system must successfully ingest distance_miles and duration_minutes from Google Routes responses and persist them in the proximity score object during unit tests.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Clear, boolean-testable requirement covering distance/duration ingestion validation in unit tests, directly aligned with the story scope.

requirements.requirement: The system must compute a normalized_score between 0 and 100 for a valid set of trials and assert all values fall within this range.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Boolean-testable assertion that normalized_score falls within 0-100 range, clear implementation path against the scoring logic.

requirements.requirement: The system must return proximity score fields (distance_miles, duration_minutes, normalized_score, metadata) in the API response via evaluate_care_facade.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Boolean-testable check for presence of specific fields in evaluate_care_facade API response, buildable and scoped correctly.

requirements.requirement: The system must ensure API responses conform to the schema defined in clinical_trials_models.py for proximity data.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Schema conformance against clinical_trials_models.py is boolean-testable and the model file exists in the codebase as an architecture constraint.

requirements.requirement: The system must include route_source and timestamp metadata in proximity results and validate their presence in integration tests.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Presence check for route_source and timestamp metadata is boolean-testable and appropriately scoped as should-have.

requirements.requirement: The system must, when the user location coordinates are identical to a trial location's coordinates (distance equals 0), assign that trial a normalized_score that is greater than or equal to the normalized_score of every other trial in the same result set.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Zero-distance edge case with assertion of highest normalized_score is boolean-testable and explicitly called out in the story description.

requirements.requirement: The system must, when processing trials that include distances exceeding 10,000 miles, return a normalized_score for every trial in the result set that is greater than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 100.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Long-distance outlier edge case with bounds assertion (not negative, not >100) is boolean-testable and directly from story scope.

requirements.requirement: The system must return a consistent number of trials before and after proximity enrichment in integration tests.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Count-before equals count-after is a clean boolean assertion ensuring enrichment doesn't drop trials, appropriate integration test.

requirements.requirement: The system must preserve original trial identifiers and core fields when adding proximity data in API responses.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Field preservation after enrichment is boolean-testable and a valid architecture constraint to prevent data corruption.

requirements.requirement: The system must handle missing or incomplete Google Routes data by skipping scoring for that trial and not breaking the full response.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Graceful degradation when Google Routes data is missing is boolean-testable (trial skipped, response intact) and is an explicit edge case from the story.

requirements.requirement: The system must ensure deterministic scoring results for identical inputs across repeated test runs.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Determinism for identical inputs is boolean-testable (run N times, assert equal outputs) and a sound architecture constraint for scoring logic.

requirements.requirement: The system must include unit tests that validate correct ingestion of distance_miles and duration_minutes from Google Routes responses.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Clear, boolean-testable requirement to validate ingestion of distance_miles and duration_minutes from Google Routes responses; implementation path is straightforward with mocked response fixtures.

requirements.requirement: The system must verify via unit tests that proximity scores are computed using both distance and duration inputs.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Boolean-testable requirement ensuring the scoring function consumes both distance and duration inputs, directly serving the story's scoring normalization goal.

requirements.requirement: The system must validate that normalized_score values are always bounded between 0 and 100 inclusive.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Clear boundary validation test for normalized_score in [0, 100]; directly codeable and essential for scoring normalization verification.

requirements.requirement: The system must include integration tests verifying that evaluate_care_facade returns proximity data in the clinical trial API response.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Clear integration test requirement targeting evaluate_care_facade returning proximity data; the facade exists in the codebase and this is directly buildable.

requirements.requirement: The system must validate that API responses include distance_miles, duration_minutes, normalized_score, and metadata fields for each trial.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Specific schema field validation test for API responses; boolean-testable by asserting presence and type of each named field.

requirements.requirement: The system must include a test case where distance_miles is zero and confirm the normalized_score reflects highest proximity.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Well-defined edge case test for zero distance with a clear expected outcome (highest proximity score); directly called out in the story description.

requirements.requirement: The system must include a test case for long-distance outliers and confirm scores are proportionally reduced without breaking normalization.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Long-distance outlier edge case explicitly called out in the story; testable by asserting score remains in valid range and proportionally reflects large distance.

requirements.requirement: The system must include an exception test where user location is missing and confirm the proximity score is not computed and is safely omitted or null.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Missing user location is an explicit edge case from the story; boolean-testable by asserting proximity score is null/omitted and no exception is raised.

requirements.requirement: The system must include an exception test where Google Routes data is unavailable and confirm fallback behavior does not crash the service.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Google Routes unavailability is a critical fault-tolerance edge case; boolean-testable by mocking a failed response and asserting no crash and graceful degradation.

requirements.requirement: The system must verify that proximity scoring logic produces deterministic outputs for identical inputs across test runs.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Determinism verification is boolean-testable (run twice, assert equal outputs) and important for scoring reliability; no duplication since REQ-004 was rejected.

requirements.requirement: The system must include tests ensuring that trials without proximity data are still returned in API responses without breaking schema validation.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Clear requirement ensuring trials without proximity data don't break schema validation; boolean-testable and addresses a real graceful-degradation scenario.

requirements.requirement: The system must include in each test output a route_source field of type string and a timestamp field of type ISO-8601 formatted datetime string, and a test must assert that both fields exist and conform to those types.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Specific metadata field validation (route_source, timestamp) with type checking; boolean-testable and complements REQ-006's broader schema check without duplicating it.

sprint_map.sprint_goal: Deliver provider scoring schema and contract

per_feature.mitigation: Enforce strict schema validation (existing requirements) and deterministic weighting; reject incomplete or non-conforming inputs at runtime.

per_measure.mitigation: ASSUMPTION: Measures will be provided upstream via existing provider data structures (ChatHealthy.Providers.json). Mitigation is to require all measures be explicitly passed and validated (no inference), and surface individual measure contributions in output to preserve transparency.
